confirm.withDigest: Confirm places the booking. The artist sees it in the app right away. The confirmation email goes out in the daily summary at {{time}}.
confirm.appOnly: Confirm places the booking and notifies the artist in the app right away.

accept.holdDescription: Hold placed. Your producer confirms next.

actionCopy.softBookedMeaning: Accepted the offer. Held for you, not booked, until you confirm.
actionCopy.tierConceptNote: Tiers are your casts in priority order. Offers open with tier 1. If it cannot fill, you open the next tier.
actionCopy.dateSourceNote: You can add a show date by hand here. If your workspace syncs from Airtable, those dates keep updating on their own, and a date you add here is not changed by a sync.
actionCopy.unrestrictedEligibility: This date has no cast limits, so anyone in {{org}} can be booked here.

cancel.title: Cancel {{artist}}'s booking?
cancel.understudyLine: If {{artist}} is in the main cast, the longest waiting accepted understudy is promoted automatically.
cancel.whoHearsFallback: The artist is notified in the app.

timingCopy.boundsError: Enter a window of at least 1 hour and digest hours between 0 and 23.

scope.offNote: These hours change nothing while the booking flow is off.
scope.directBookDeadFields: You book artists directly, so the offer window and the offer digest hour change nothing.
scope.onlyConfirmationLive: Only the confirmation hour is live.
scope.confirmationHourStillLive: The confirmation hour still runs: it sets when booked artists are notified of schedule changes in the app.

tonight.directConfirm: Newly confirmed artists get the confirmation digest at {{time}}.
tonight.digestConfirm_one: When a tier opens, offers go out in the next {{offerTime}} digest. Artists get {{count}} hour to answer, and confirmations mail at {{time}}.
tonight.digestConfirm_other: When a tier opens, offers go out in the next {{offerTime}} digest. Artists get {{count}} hours to answer, and confirmations mail at {{time}}.
tonight.digestNoConfirm_one: When a tier opens, offers go out in the next {{offerTime}} digest. Artists get {{count}} hour to answer.
tonight.digestNoConfirm_other: When a tier opens, offers go out in the next {{offerTime}} digest. Artists get {{count}} hours to answer.
tonight.immediateConfirm_one: When a tier opens, offers email straight away. Artists get {{count}} hour to answer, and confirmations mail at {{time}}.
tonight.immediateConfirm_other: When a tier opens, offers email straight away. Artists get {{count}} hours to answer, and confirmations mail at {{time}}.
tonight.immediateNoConfirm_one: When a tier opens, offers email straight away. Artists get {{count}} hour to answer.
tonight.immediateNoConfirm_other: When a tier opens, offers email straight away. Artists get {{count}} hours to answer.

upNext.direct: Direct booking: producers book from the eligibility list

hireFooter.detailReady: All slots confirmed, drafts one order per artist
